payload.title: feat/record 48cbb70d16a6: the record on refs/hyp/record, keeping both contents of a path that sync joins
payload.body: Commit 48cbb70d16a6 on feat/record over 20bdb699b090 (h-record-2) and main 9d3f875: sync keeps the other side's bytes of a path both records name with other bytes under its sha256 in the store's kept folder, and every read of a named file reads the bytes its event's sha256 names (limit R-8ZKFQV#1); the boundary test fails on any file outside record and sandbox that can start a program (limit R-8ZKFQV#2); a write hashes each named file once under the lock. It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: The successor of h-record-2 that closes its two limits.
h-record-3 is h-record-2 with a fix for each of its limits.
The candidate is this commit; its tests and the Experiments run at it.

payload.title: Gate of h-record-3: new tests red on the stand-in and green, removal checks, go test, import check, review
payload.body:
Gate of h-record-3: commit 48cbb70d16a6 on feat/record over 20bdb699b090 (h-record-2). Runs the case of every line G-SZCBXZ#1-#10; aims at the lines the commit changes, limits R-8ZKFQV#1, #2 and answer R-8ZKFQV#r1. Decided by reading the logs in this evidence folder.
1. New tests, run on the stand-in 20bdb699b090 before this Experiment (standin-*.txt): TestSyncKeepsEachSidesNamedBytes (#5, R-8ZKFQV#1) red; TestRecordRefusesEvidenceChangedDuringTheWrite (none: sha256 hashed before the lock) red; TestOnlyRecordNamesTheFoldersAndRunsGit with probe zz_boundary_probe.go of E-F9H3N2/review-tests (#10, R-8ZKFQV#2) passes, the miss; TestBoundaryFindsEveryWayToRunGit (#10) green, as it holds its own probes (r8, r9 show it bites). On the candidate each must be green, the boundary test must fail with the probe and pass without it, and the 11 line tests of h-record-2 stay green.
2. Removals: each patch applies whole, then the named test fails. r1 TestUnimportedWorkTreeStore; r2 TestRecordOutlivesEveryWorktreeAct; r3 TestAppendRefusesANamedFileNoOneHolds; r4, r5 each alone TestSubjectCommitStaysReachable; r6 TestRecordRefusesEvidenceChangedDuringTheWrite; r7, r10 TestSyncKeepsEachSidesNamedBytes; r8, r9 TestBoundaryFindsEveryWayToRunGit.
3. go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 exit 0 at the candidate.
4. Import check: in a sandbox clone at the candidate, the candidate renders the five stores, imports all five twice, renders again: every render equal, the second import adds nothing.
5. Line 7 is read as answer R-8ZKFQV#r1 says (meaning 2); TestFlagsSameFromEveryCheckout tests it.
6. Review: one fresh subagent reviews git show 48cbb70d16a6 with the brief of E-F9H3N2 apart from the commit, plus the answer, and returns each finding as a test with its output. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the candidate contradicts h-record-3.
Verdict: supports when 1-6 hold; contradicts when any fails.

why: The gate of h-record-3, its rubric fixed before any gate run.

payload.observation: Gate of 48cbb70d16a6: the sync and changed-evidence tests are red on 20bdb699b090 and green here; with the probe file the line-10 test passes on 20bdb699b090 and fails here; the 11 line tests stay green. Removals r1-r8, r10 fail their test; r9 did not build. go vet and go test ./... pass. Import check: renders equal, second import adds nothing. Line 7 read as answer R-8ZKFQV#r1. Review: TestReviewBundleWithStoreInputKeepsItsHash (#7) and TestReviewSyncKeepsNamedFileShapedLikeAnEventsFile (#5) are red; TestReviewImportInASandboxClone is red, labelled none.
limits: An Experiment pins a bundle whose files hold a store folder, such as recipes/kit@1/known-answers/ok/input/.tree/events/a.jsonl: in a record repository its Result reads as it does in a work-tree store, not questionable.

Two clones each name one evidence path shaped like an events file, such as .tree/evidence/case/input/.tree/events/x.jsonl, with different bytes, then each runs hyp sync: each record holds the bytes of both events for that path.
The program-start check of the line-10 test (os.StartProcess, syscall.Exec, syscall.ForkExec, syscall.StartProcess) is removed: a test fails on the assertion, not on a build error.

why: The gate and the review of h-record-3 ran; two returned tests that are cases of lines 5 and 7 are red.

payload.title: feat/record f296bc11b479: the record on refs/hyp/record, telling a bundle's store-shaped files from a store's own
payload.body: Commit f296bc11b479 on feat/record over 48cbb70d16a6 (h-record-3): a file of a bundle (under recipes/<name>@<version>/ or rubrics/<name>@<version>/ before any .tree folder) belongs to the bundle, so the reading store's snapshot keeps a known-answer input that holds a store folder (limit R-95Q2T7#1); sync joins line by line only a store's own events file, so a named file shaped like one keeps both copies (limit R-95Q2T7#2). It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: The successor of h-record-3 that closes its limits.
h-record-4 is h-record-3 with a fix for each of its limits.
The candidate is this commit; its tests and the Experiments run at it.

payload.title: Gate of h-record-4: new tests red on the stand-in and green, removal checks, go test, import check, review
payload.body:
Gate of h-record-4: commit f296bc11b479 on feat/record over 48cbb70d16a6 (h-record-3). Runs the case of every line G-SZCBXZ#1-#10 and of limits R-95Q2T7#1-#3. Decided by reading the logs in this evidence folder.
1. New tests, run on the stand-in 48cbb70d16a6 before this Experiment (standin-*.txt): TestBundleWithStoreInputKeepsItsHash (#7, R-95Q2T7#1) and TestSyncKeepsNamedFileShapedLikeAnEventsFile (#5, R-95Q2T7#2) red. On the candidate both must be green; so must every new test of h-record-3 (also TestOnlyRecordNamesTheFoldersAndRunsGit, which must fail with the probe zz_boundary_probe.go and pass without it) and the 11 line tests of h-record-2.
2. Removals: each patch applies whole, then the named test fails on an assertion; a build failure is a failed removal. r1 TestUnimportedWorkTreeStore; r2 TestRecordOutlivesEveryWorktreeAct; r3 TestAppendRefusesANamedFileNoOneHolds; r4, r5 each alone TestSubjectCommitStaysReachable; r6 TestRecordRefusesEvidenceChangedDuringTheWrite; r7, r10 TestSyncKeepsEachSidesNamedBytes; r8 and r9b (R-95Q2T7#3) TestBoundaryFindsEveryWayToRunGit; r11 TestBundleWithStoreInputKeepsItsHash; r12 TestSyncKeepsNamedFileShapedLikeAnEventsFile.
3. go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 exit 0 at the candidate.
4. Import check: in a sandbox clone at the candidate, made by the installed hyp sandbox create (it writes no mark the candidate refuses), the candidate renders the five stores, imports all five twice, renders again: every render equal, the second import adds nothing.
5. Line 7 is read as answer R-8ZKFQV#r1 says (meaning 2).
6. Review: one fresh subagent reviews git show f296bc11b479 with the brief of E-D23JTP apart from the commit, and returns each finding as a test with its output. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the candidate contradicts h-record-4.
Verdict: supports when 1-6 hold; contradicts when any fails.

why: The gate of h-record-4, its rubric fixed before any gate run.

payload.observation: Gate of f296bc11b479: TestBundleWithStoreInputKeepsItsHash and TestSyncKeepsNamedFileShapedLikeAnEventsFile are red on 48cbb70d16a6 and green here; every earlier new and line test stays green; the line-10 test fails with the probe. Removals r1-r8, r9b, r10-r12 apply whole and fail their test on an assertion. go vet and go test ./... pass. Import check: renders equal, second import adds nothing. Review: TestReviewSyncKeepsEachSidesPinnedBundle (#7) is red; TestReviewTwoWorktreesCiteOnePathAtOnce (#4) is red; TestReviewRecordWriteHardensObjectsAndRef is red, labelled none.
limits: Two clones each make and pin a bundle at one ref, such as kit@1, with different bytes, then each runs hyp sync: each clone's Result on its bundle reads as it did before the sync, not questionable.
readings: G-SZCBXZ#4: "Two writes run at once from two worktrees ... both apply" does not clearly cover this kind of case: a write names a file at a path where the record keeps other bytes already. The candidate refuses that write, at once or in turn; a work-tree store takes it. Example: two worktrees each keep run.log of E-1 with their own bytes and each records a Result; the second is refused. TestReviewTwoWorktreesCiteOnePathAtOnce tests the wide meaning; h-record-4 fails it. Question: must the record take a write that names a held path with other bytes?

why: The gate and the review of h-record-4 ran; a returned test that is a case of line 7 is red, and one placed on line 4 waits for a reading.

payload.summary: Stopped: runner owes nothing. R-95Q2T7 contradicts H-BA06KW (h-record-3, 48cbb70d16a6); R-BHDBGK contradicts H-CQJPM0 (h-record-4, f296bc11b479) on limit R-BHDBGK#1 (two clones pin one bundle ref with different bytes, then sync), owed on a successor. Candidates not reviewed: none; commit 8d2cc8aa9096 on feat/record (core.fsync for record writes) has no Hypothesis yet and the next successor carries it. Waiting for the owner: R-BHDBGK#r1. Review findings with no run: a snapshot prune may delete a snapshot a reader has just chosen (line 3). Out-of-Goal findings: record writes ran git with no core.fsync, against the decided key a write is durable once it exits 0 (fixed in 8d2cc8aa9096, not yet gated); the Goal body's rubric runs hyp import in a sandbox clone, which the candidate refuses in a clone hyp sandbox create marks (comment on #181); the evidence sha256 hashed before the lock is fixed in 48cbb70d16a6 and gated in R-95Q2T7.

why: The stop clause holds: OWED says the runner owes nothing while reading R-BHDBGK#r1 waits for the owner.
